You are opening a new web application for the first time. Instead of wondering where everything is, the website walks you through each important feature with beautiful popups and highlighted elements.
This is exactly what Driver.js was built for.
Whether you’re building a SaaS application, admin dashboard, portfolio, or internal company software, Driver.js lets you create interactive product tours, feature introductions, contextual help, and focus effects with just a few lines of code.
The best part?

• Zero dependencies

• Only 5KB (gzipped)

• Written in TypeScript

• Works in every major browser

• Completely customizable

• MIT Licensed
Let’s learn how it works.
Press enter or click to view image in full size

What is Driver.js?
Driver.js is a lightweight JavaScript library that lets you place an overlay on your webpage and highlight specific elements.
Instead of users having to guess how your application works, Driver.js guides them step by step.
